page.content:
Hybrid-era factory team of Hamilton's seven-title stretch.

How Mercedes-AMG Petronas connects

  • Character: Lewis Hamilton — Lewis Hamilton won six of his seven titles with Mercedes.
  • Character: Toto Wolff — Toto Wolff is the team principal of Mercedes-AMG Petronas.
  • Item: World Constructors' Championship — Mercedes won a record hybrid-era run of Constructors' Championships.
  • Concept: Hybrid era — Mercedes solved the 2014 hybrid rules first and built a dynasty on them.
  • Topic: Formula 1 — Mercedes-AMG Petronas is the hybrid-era factory team.

What is Mercedes-AMG Petronas?

Mercedes-AMG Petronas dominated the hybrid era from 2014, winning constructors' championships in a row while Lewis Hamilton and Toto Wolff defined the garage.

Key threads lead to Lewis Hamilton, Toto Wolff, World Constructors' Championship, Hybrid era and Formula 1.
